Everything is complete, precise, and meets all instructions.### The Glory of Jael
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/glory-of-jael
Passage: Judges 5:24-31
Points:
- In Deborah's song, Jael is celebrated as most blessed among women for bringing down Sisera.
- Although her husband Heber maintained peace with Canaanite oppressors, Jael chose loyalty to the Lord and His people.
- She acted courageously during wartime to overcome a cruel military commander who had inflicted immense suffering on Israel.
- Jael accomplished this deliverance using everyday tools—a tent peg and mallet—that tent-dwelling women practiced with daily.
- God does not need extraordinary status or skills, but delights to accomplish great victories through ordinary people faithful with what they have.
